caseName: Central Illinois Public Service Co. v. Illinois Commerce Comm'n
caseNameFull: CENTRAL ILLINOIS PUBLIC SERVICE CO. v. ILLINOIS COMMERCE COMM'N
attorneys: Elmer Nafziger for appellant., William L. Guild, Attorney General of Illinois, Harry R. Begley, Special Assistant Attorney General, John W. Foster, Robert Mitten, Joseph H. Wright and Herbert J. Deany for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
